acceptance.output_evidence: THE READING, in five parts, recorded with NO verdict. (1) THE PLANT EXERCISES THE SAME CODE PATH A REAL MISS WOULD: _last_full_before_boundary (graph_status_cli.py:329-382) computes the boundary from the wall clock, finds no full/derive_runner manifest inside [boundary, boundary+6h), walks backwards for the newest full and returns ran=False; the plant reaches that branch with an empty window, a real miss reaches it with a window of incrementals that fail the mode=='full' AND writer_id=='derive_runner' test. STATED LIMIT: the plant does not exercise the REJECTION half of the window scan (its window is empty, so 0 of the up-to-12 in-window manifest GETs are spent rejecting incrementals). (2) REALISTIC ON SHAPE, NOT MERELY ON VERDICT: 14 fields, same names and nesting as the live S3 manifest read minutes earlier (the two projection.current blocks in the transcripts differ only in values), IN-BAND band status, writer_id derive_runner, producer.mode full, and its manifest_sha256 VERIFIES -- so it passes the straddle contract (graph_status_cli.py:282-296) rather than short-circuiting it into the UNVERIFIABLE branch at :419/:485. (3) THE COUNTERFACTUAL WAS NOT TESTED AROUND: a real miss needs the nightly rule disabled or a task stopped, a production change no worker may make and a NEVER on this order's face; it was not done. (4) WHAT A GRADER MAY HOLD AGAINST THE FIXTURE, said by the seat that built the reading: the plant proves the DECISION FUNCTION answers NO when no full nightly landed in the window; it does not prove the ESTATE would deliver that NO to an operator during a real miss, because in a real miss the pointer would also be stale and the reader would be talking to S3 rather than a local directory -- read_method: local-file in the NO transcript is the printed tell that this arm ran against a fixture. The honest statement: decision function EXERCISED, delivery path under a real miss INFERRED from shared code. (5) ON THE SECOND HALF -- whether the morning read's time matches D-9's night: it does, exactly, on both fields (built_at 2026-09-05T02:23:22.179104+00:00 and vintage 2026-09-05T02:11:10.919000+00:00), and the match was made by comparing two independently produced numbers rather than by carrying D-9's forward; no later full nightly exists in the window, so it is CG-x-2's own night. This is the half the worker would rate strongest.
